Shenmue / NIN - The Downward Spiral.

The contrast of the loud abrasiveness of TDS and Ryu's mostly calm demeanor plus the dark themes of the album give Ryu's revenge quest a new seething edge. I don't know if anyone else would get the same vibe but I recommend giving it a shot.

Dreamfall: The Longest Journey / Sunny Day Real Estate - The Rising Tide
